name: coc_event_fields

ownership.argument: Which fields of the work buffer each CoC event branch reads, taken from the handlers that 0xC81E2F8 posts: event1 reads the u16 at +0 and writes channel setup fields (+32, +52, +56); event2 reads the u16 at +4 and works from +8; event3 reads the u16 at +28, +72, +108 and +114; event5 is handled inline in the dispatcher and clears the u16 at +4 (data path); event6 works from +0; event7 reads the dword at +4; event8 reads the u16 at +2; event12 reads the flag byte at +17 bit0 and the byte at +16; event13 does the same and compares the 24-byte peer address at +24 against a channel; event14 reads the byte at +132, the u16 at +130 and the area at +106. The numbers stand for connection setup, data, and close paths, but the mapping number-to-name is NOT proven and must not be hardcoded as names.

provenance.source: Dispatchers: 0xC81E2F8 (registered for PSM 31 and 4) switches on 1,2,3,5,6,7,8,12,13,14 and posts handlers 0xC81EFA0, 0xC81EAF0, 0xC81E90C, (inline 5), 0xC81EA88, 0xC81E454, 0xC81E3EC, 0xC81EF04, 0xC81E84C, 0xC81E9B4 with work flag 1; 0xC806AC8 (PSM 1) switches on the subset 1,2,3,5,6,7. Field reads were taken from each posted handler.

notes: Routing is safe by field usage; naming is a hole and stays out of the module.
